description: Compose paste-ready <audiodn-player> HTML for a collection or track. Offline — does not mint credentials. Typical flow: resolve the resource (adn_find_resource), mint a scoped Client-Side Player key (adn_create_client_key, api_key_type_id "player"), then call this with that key. Alternatively pass a server-minted play_session_id. Never pass a server API Access key. See adn_get_guide topic "web-components" for attributes and theming.

api_key.description: Scoped Client-Side Player key (from adn_create_client_key). Never a server API Access key. Provide exactly one of api_key or play_session_id.

cdn.description: CDN for the player script (default unpkg).

downloadable.description: Request download UI; the key/session must allow downloads for it to work.

height.description: Inline layout button height (CSS length or number of px).

id.description: Track or collection UUID matching scope.

layout.description: Player layout. default = full player; inline = compact play/pause with progress ring (no track info). Emitted as the component variant attribute.

pin.description: Package version pin (default "latest"). Prefer a concrete semver for production embeds.

play_session_id.description: Server-minted play session ID. Provide exactly one of api_key or play_session_id.

size.description: Player layout size for the default layout: x-small, small, or regular (default). Omitted from the snippet when regular.

variants.description: Comma-separated delivery output indexes in priority order (e.g. "hq,lq" or ["hq","lq"]). Emitted as the variants attribute the published package reads.

name: adn_build_player_embed
